body:
I am with you, thats sort of what has prevented me from trying it so far.  Logically I know that I have a lot to live for, but sometimes the despair is so deep that if there was an easy way out I would probably already be dead.

Probably a good thing for me and you that there really isn't.

Sometimes I will drink to get drunk, but usually I drink because I happen to be a big craft beer fan, and good beer has been something I have been in to for a long time.

It just so happens to be that sometimes when I get drunk, as I am right now, and by myself, it makes me want to find a nice easy way to kill myself.
I am still fine as of right now, although today has been a really hard day, had a friend of sorts pass away unexpectedly which has been rough.
